reason: We do the zoo for free on Saturdays and $15 a kid every visit adds up fast for a weekend-only outing. I might use the free first visit once, but I would not pay after that.
objection: $15 per kid per visit when the zoo and the park cost nothing, and it feels more like an Instagram thing than something Salisbury needs.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $8 to $10 per kid, or a cheap weekend-friendly pass, plus proof it is actually clean and uncrowded on Saturdays.
